news.title: Mahesh Babu's Post-Varanasi Venture Sparks Speculation
news.summary: Mahesh Babu is nearing the completion of his portions for SS Rajamouli's Varanasi, which is scheduled for a worldwide release on April 7, 2027. While various prominent directors have been linked to his upcoming venture, recent buzz has introduced Lokesh Kanagaraj into the conversation following a banner collaboration announcement. However, there remains no official confirmation regarding an actor-director partnership between Mahesh and Lokesh.

news.title: Nani and Srikanth Odela Address The Paradise Dialogue Backlash
news.summary: Following mixed reactions to a specific line in The Paradise where a character is labeled a single-take artist, actor Nani and director Srikanth Odela addressed the controversy in a post-release interview. The filmmaker clarified that the dialogue was intended as an ironic realization, but the necessary childhood backstory was trimmed from the final cut to manage the runtime. Consequently, the missing setup led to audience misunderstanding, though the film continues its strong box office momentum.

news.title: Taapsee Pannu Serves Striking Retro Elegance in New Photoshoot
news.summary: Taapsee Pannu has once again captured attention by sharing bold new pictures showcasing a vintage fashion aesthetic with voluminous curls and a floral mini dress. Despite facing a challenging box office run with her recent releases, the actress continues to make headlines with her distinct style choices. She is currently filming Woh Ladki Hai Kahaan?, where she portrays ACP Komal Sharma.

news.title: Sai Durga Tej Starrer Sambarala Yeti Gattu to Maintain Sankranti Schedule
news.summary: The makers of the mass action entertainer Sambarala Yeti Gattu have confirmed that the film will stick to its scheduled theatrical release on January 12, 2027, as a Sankranti special. Despite speculation that the team might alter their plans following the announcement of Chiranjeevi's Kaaka for the adjacent date, producer Chaitanya Reddy affirmed that post-production is nearing completion. The Rohith KP directorial stars Sai Durga Tej alongside Aishwarya Lekshmi and a prominent supporting cast.

news.title: Hombale Films Acquires Southern Rights for Hanuman Ansh
news.summary: The low-budget Hindi success Hanuman Ansh is expanding its reach into southern languages. Production powerhouse Hombale Films has secured the dubbing rights for the regional release. The trilogy's first installment depicts the journey of Lakshmi Narayan leading to his transformation into Neem Karoli Baba.

news.title: NTR To Kickstart Mumbai Schedule for Dragon
news.summary: Following a break due to a shoulder injury, actor NTR is gearing up to resume shooting for Prashanth Neel's directorial venture, Dragon. A two-week schedule featuring high-voltage action stunts is slated to begin in Mumbai on October 10. The big-budget project is backed by Mythri Movie Makers and NTR Arts.

news.title: Anil Ravipudi’s January 12 Vidudala Nears Completion
news.summary: Director Anil Ravipudi is rapidly wrapping up production on his upcoming film, January 12 Vidudala, starring Venkatesh, Kalyanram, Keerthy Suresh, and Krithi Shetty. The team will head to Ooty in October for a fresh schedule before moving abroad for song sequences. The theatrical release is locked for January 12.

news.title: Nani’s The Paradise Maintains Strong Box Office Momentum
news.summary: Nani's latest outing, The Paradise, directed by Srikanth Odela, continues to enjoy steady collections and high footfalls. Family audiences are turning out in droves over the holiday weekend, bolstering advance bookings. The feature marks a career milestone as the actor's highest opener to date.

news.title: Chakkora Trailer Unveils a Unique Blend of Romance and Mystery
news.summary: The theatrical trailer for the upcoming romantic drama Chakkora has officially arrived, introducing viewers to a playful protagonist whose life turns upside down when his love interest suddenly vanishes. Directed by Manga Srinivas and starring Sravan alongside Malaika T. Vasupal, the film combines youthful romance with unexpected suspense. Set for an October 9 theatrical release, the project features a musical backdrop scored by Prince Henry.

news.title: First-Look Materials for Ramayana Highlight Epic Scale and Divine Aesthetics
news.summary: Director Nitesh Tiwari's ambitious mythological project Ramayana has generated massive buzz with fresh promotional material featuring Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, and Yash. The newly revealed stills showcase a serene depiction of Lord Rama alongside his divine companions against breathtaking natural scenery. Meanwhile, the first look of Yash as the powerful antagonist Ravana emphasizes regal authority and intense detail ahead of its scheduled two-part holiday release.

news.title: Fresh Sneak Peek of Chakkora Highlights Youthful Energy and Dramatic Twists
news.summary: The promotional campaign for Chakkora gained further momentum as the film's trailer was unveiled in Hyderabad by Aakash Jagannadh. The narrative follows an easygoing young man who embarks on a passionate pursuit after crossing paths with a mysterious woman, only for the plot to pivot into uncharted dramatic territory. Backed by High Joy Commercials, the film aims to deliver a fresh emotional experience for moviegoers.

news.title: Nani Starrer The Paradise Maintains Impressive Box Office Momentum
news.summary: Despite facing mixed initial reviews after its mid-week premiere, Nani's latest movie The Paradise has surprised trade circles by maintaining strong box office numbers. Directed by Srikanth Odela, the action drama crossed a notable worldwide gross milestone within its first three days while showing significant growth in domestic and overseas markets. The core team recently celebrated this commercial success at a public event boosted by positive audience reception.

news.title: NTR Set to Restart Dragon Shoot in Mumbai Following Recovery
news.summary: Actor NTR is recovering from a shoulder injury and surgery that kept him sidelined for nearly two months. He will join Anil Kapoor in Mumbai on October 10 for a 15-day schedule focused on action sequences for Prashanth Neel's directorial venture Dragon.

news.title: The Paradise Faces Crucial Box Office Test on Monday
news.summary: Nani's big-budget movie The Paradise achieved strong opening weekend numbers, hitting roughly ₹120 crore gross by Saturday with expectations of nearing ₹150 crore by Sunday. However, the film received mixed reactions regarding its emotional connection and screenplay, setting up a high-stakes Monday box office test to reach its ₹220 crore target.

news.title: Fresh Character Posters Unveiled for Upcoming Epic Ramayana
news.summary: The makers of the pan-Indian adaptation Ramayana have released two new character posters highlighting Yash as a regal Ravana alongside the divine trio of Ram, Lakshmana, and Sita. Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, the multi-part project features music by AR Rahman and Hans Zimmer and is slated for Diwali releases in 2026 and 2027.

news.title: Makers of King100 Prepare Special Teaser to Reveal Tabu's Role
news.summary: Nagarjuna Akkineni's milestone project King100 is gearing up to release a promotional video introducing Tabu's character. The film reunites Nagarjuna and Tabu on screen years after their 1990s hit Ninne Pelladutha, with a theatrical release scheduled for December 24, 2026.

news.title: Vijay Deverakonda and Team to Launch Four-Part Promotional Docu-Series for Ranabaali
news.summary: As part of the promotional campaign for the historical drama Ranabaali, the team is rolling out a four-part documentary series titled Ranabaali: Never Forget. The project, stemming from two years of historical research into Rayalaseema, features lead actor Vijay Deverakonda, Rashmika Mandanna, and director Rahul Sankrityan discussing the film's background. Directed by Rahul Sankrityan and backed by Mythri Movie Makers, the movie is lined up for an October 16, 2026 theatrical release.

news.title: BRS Leader KTR Praises Nani Starrer The Paradise After Hyderabad Screening
news.summary: BRS Working President KTR caught a screening of the Nani-starrer The Paradise at Hyderabad's Sudarshan Theatre alongside various public representatives. He commended the cast, director Srikanth Odela, and the crew for effectively capturing Telangana's linguistic and cultural identity. Furthermore, he noted that the movie successfully spotlights the struggles of marginalized communities and organized resistance against oppression.

news.title: Industry Reports Indicate Higher Digital Streaming Value for Rashmika Mandanna Over Sai Pallavi
news.summary: According to industry insights, digital streaming platforms are reportedly offering higher valuations for female-centric projects led by Rashmika Mandanna compared to those starring Sai Pallavi. Insiders attribute this pricing gap to Rashmika's involvement in pan-Indian blockbusters like Pushpa 2 and Animal, coupled with her extensive social media footprint. Meanwhile, Sai Pallavi maintains a strong reputation for performance-driven roles and selective cinematic appearances.

news.title: Nani Starrer The Paradise Maintains Steady Ticket Sales on Day 3
news.summary: Despite mixed initial talk, the Nani-led film The Paradise continues to perform strongly at the ticket counters. On its third day, the movie recorded 252K ticket sales on BookMyShow, holding ground nearly on par with the second day. The cast and crew recently interacted with the media to share their thoughts on the project, backed by producer Sudhakar Cherukuri and directed by Srikanth Odela.

news.title: Wildcard Contestant Mithilesh Exits Bigg Boss Telugu 10 With Cash Prize
news.summary: In a surprising development inside the Bigg Boss Telugu Season 10 house, recent wildcard entrant Mithilesh chose to accept a 15 lakh rupees temptation offer and exit the show. Entering the house just a day prior, he explained his decision by stating that house dynamics and circumstances made it impossible for him to secure a win. This unexpected move marks a first-of-its-kind early exit in the reality television series.

news.title: Actor Nani Calls The Paradise a Long-Term Box Office Contender
news.summary: During a recent media interaction in Hyderabad, actor Nani expressed joy over audiences eventually embracing his latest film, The Paradise, despite early negative reactions. He lauded the entire technical and directing team, calling the project a horse suited for a long race. Nani also shared appreciation for his co-stars and crew members, including director Srikanth Odela and composer Anirudh.

news.title: Mohan Babu Calls His Role in The Paradise the Deadliest of His Career
news.summary: Veteran actor Mohan Babu spoke at a press meet for The Paradise, sharing that his character in the Srikanth Odela directorial is the most intense role in his 50-year acting journey. He praised the uncompromising vision of producer Sudhakar Cherukuri and commended Nani for his exceptional dedication and hard work. The actor expressed high praise for the director's potential and filmmaking approach.

news.title: Nani Highlights The Unusual Box Office Trajectory Of The Paradise
news.summary: During a media interaction for The Paradise, actor Nani shared that his film witnessed an unprecedented upward trend where audience reactions shifted from negative to positive with each screening. Directed by Srikanth Odela and backed by producer Sudhakar Cherukuri, the big-budget project features an ensemble cast including Mohan Babu, Raghav Juyal, Sonali Kulkarni, and Kayadu Lohar.
